::: {#hero-heading}

I'm an AI researcher with a **Ph.D. in Computer Science** (minor: Statistics) from Iowa State University, and a current **AI Safety Research Fellow at [Algoverse](https://algoverseairesearch.org/ai-safety-fellowship)**.

My path into research started with a practical question: *how do we build systems that behave reliably when the real world doesn't cooperate?* That question pulled me from software engineering at Comcast into a PhD focused on safety-critical control for smart energy infrastructure — and eventually toward the broader challenge of making AI systems trustworthy at scale.

I work at the intersection of **deep reinforcement learning**, **AI safety**, and **physical systems** — building agents that not only perform well, but can be trusted in high-stakes environments.

:::

## <i class="fas fa-flask"></i> Research

My doctoral work centered on **physics-informed deep reinforcement learning** for smart grid control: embedding domain knowledge, safety constraints, and uncertainty directly into the learning process so agents make reliable decisions under distribution shifts and partial observability.

Over time, *"how do we keep agents safe?"* scaled beyond energy systems. I now focus on **AI safety and alignment** more broadly:

```{=html}
<div class="focus-grid">

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">🔬</span>
    <div class="focus-title">Agentic Evaluations</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Designing behavioral and mechanistic tests to detect reward hacking, deceptive alignment, and obfuscated internal states in LLM-based agents.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">🛡️</span>
    <div class="focus-title">Adversarial Robustness</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Understanding and hardening AI systems against distributional attacks, prompt injection, and specification gaming in both classical and foundation model pipelines.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">🔭</span>
    <div class="focus-title">Scalable Oversight</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Exploring how humans and increasingly capable AI systems can collaborate to maintain meaningful supervision at scale.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">⚡</span>
    <div class="focus-title">Safe RL for CPS</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Physics-informed DRL with Bayesian uncertainty quantification, constraint satisfaction, and transfer learning for smart energy infrastructure.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">🤖</span>
    <div class="focus-title">LLM-Integrated Agents</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Frameworks connecting perception, planning, and language reasoning for autonomous systems — bridging interpretable decision-making with low-level control.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="focus-card">
    <span class="focus-icon">👁️</span>
    <div class="focus-title">Autonomous Perception</div>
    <div class="focus-desc">Vision-based perception (detection, segmentation, sensor fusion) integrated with learning-based control and trajectory planning.</div>
  </div>

</div>
```

For a full account of projects and publications, see the [Research](/rpkg/research.qmd) and [Projects](/projects.qmd) pages.
